source_documents.title: A self-assembly induced emission system constructed by the host–guest interaction of AIE-active building blocks

reference_evidence_units.quote: which perform as the host and guest molecules due to their dibenzo[24]crown-8 moieties and benzylamino groups, respectively.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE–DDBC
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source identifies TPE–DDBC as the host building block of the TPE-DDBC/TPE-DBA system.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Name/function mapping only; molecular graph, E/Z configuration and legacy SMILES remain unverified. DBA is reported as an E/Z mixture.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Fluorescence (FL) spectra of (A) TPE–DBA and (C) TPE–DDBC
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE–DDBC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 10 micromolar THF/water, excitation 360 nm; Fig. 1 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Target-specific Fig. 1C-D shows weak low-water emission and strong enhancement at high water fractions, with blue-region fluorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The two compounds have separate traces. Do not transfer the DBA threshold or quantitative enhancement to DDBC; no numerical DDBC threshold is claimed.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the protonated amines are capable of recognizing the crown ethers
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE–DDBC in the two-component mixture
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Equimolar TPE-DBA/TPE-DDBC in THF; acid/base switching, Fig. 2A.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Protonation permits ammonium-crown binding; base-induced deionization is proposed to dissociate the supramolecular assembly.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Ground-state protonation is not ESIPT. Detailed stoichiometry/association kinetics are not established by the inspected main text.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the emis- sion from the TPE moiety in TPE–DDBC can also be partially initiated
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE–DDBC in the two-component assembly
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Acidified equimolar mixture; source's target-specific RIR explanation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors propose that forming supramolecular macromolecules damps phenyl rotations and partially initiates emission of the DDBC host's own TPE unit.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The fluorescent mixture was not spectrally decomposed into separate guest and host contributions; retain the author's proposed attribution, not measured component fractions.

reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE–DDBC with complementary building block
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Each building block 5e-4 M in THF, 1:1; HCl/NaOH aqueous stocks 1 M; excitation 360 nm; Fig. 2B-C inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Acid produces a fluorescent white precipitate after 10 min sonication; base removes precipitate and fluorescence. Three cycles are shown.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: These are mixture-level measurements, not isolated-target acid/base titrations. PDF extraction corrupts microliter glyphs; do not use the extracted mL aliquots literally.

reference_evidence_units.quote: such low water fraction cannot lead to the aggregation of TPE–DBA and TPE–DDBC.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE–DDBC with complementary building block
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Control comparison between approximately 2% cumulative water after three acid/base cycles and Fig. 1 solvent titrations.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors argue the initial turn-on is from host-guest-induced insoluble assembly, not water alone.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is a water-fraction control, not a complete exclusion of ionic strength, counterion or protonation-related contributions.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the emission became stronger and the emission peak blue-shifted after every cycle.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE–DDBC in cyclic mixture assemblies
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Three acid/base cycles, Fig. 2B-C and Fig. 3.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors associate stepwise intensity increases with tighter packing as water accumulates, and blue shifts with increased structural order/twisting.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The cycle is reversible in on/off behavior but not identical in brightness. Packing/twisting explanation is proposed, not molecularly resolved.

reference_evidence_units.quote: microscopic wires with diameters of about 100 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE–DDBC in mixture assemblies
reference_evidence_units.statement: Acidified mixtures form bundled wire-like networks; base-treated material becomes featureless. Wire widths grow from about 100 nm toward over 500 nm over cycles.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SEM samples are prepared solids; morphology does not by itself quantify internal rotation or resolve each component.

reference_evidence_units.quote: can form a strongly-bonded counter-ion pair with a protonated secondary amine
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE–DDBC in chloride-containing assembly
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Discussion of chloride and alternative anions.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors note that chloride can compete through strong ion pairing, and suggest PF6 or BF4 as potentially better anions for host-guest interaction.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Alternative counterions are a proposal, not experiments inspected here; retain this limitation on the HCl-driven model.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Target-specific author interpretation links supramolecular assembly to restricted phenyl rotations. Component emission fractions and torsional dynamics were not measured.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Precipitation, network formation and changing microstructure provide the environment for RIR and cycle-dependent intensity/color changes.

reference_mechanisms.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Source assigns acid-enabled ammonium-crown recognition to the two-component assembly and its reversible emission response; target role is explicitly host.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific CT excited-state mechanism is established here; donor-acceptor structure alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Acid/base protonation enables host binding in the ground state; no excited-state proton-transfer mechanism is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific photoinduced electron-transfer pathway is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The blue shift and assembly morphology are attributed to packing/twisting, not an explicitly identified exciton or excimer state.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct radiative-rate or state-population explanation is established; intensity or lifetime changes alone do not isolate it.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet or metal/energy-transfer photophysics is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection pathway is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
